entry_condition: Start transfer/push only if the plug repair produces trustworthy physically audited learning and the parent reviews completed reward screens and HP results. This manifest does not make that decision.
scope: Read-only readiness audit plus this saved manifest. No new grid, long-rollout implementation or GPU job.

critic_fix.label: critic_bootstrap_memory_restore_v1
critic_fix.applicability: Both tasks use the same recurrent critic and CompactPPO. The value bootstrap restores critic memory; actor inputs, physics, objective and success definitions are unchanged.

existing_launchers.array_index_rule: 3*condition_index+seed; seed0 indices: wrist0, static3, wrist_static6, initial9, scheduled12, active15.
existing_launchers.bound: Override the array to a single selected index (for example --array=6%1). Default concurrency6 exceeds the current four-GPU study limit; never launch the default full array for this readiness check.

transfer.object: 24mm cube from tray into tall open cubby

push.object: 30x24x18mm block pushed with fixed closed gripper and 8 mm radius tip

objective_and_success_applicability.legacy_log_hold: Rejected for transfer/push; this corrected-distance1000-bonus profile is plug-only.
objective_and_success_applicability.current_qpos_scope: Fresh configs carry current_qpos, but the qpos success branch is implemented only for plug. Transfer/push retain derived object/TCP positions and derived object velocity; the 2 ms sampling lag needs task-specific physical auditing before paper-level success claims.
objective_and_success_applicability.audit_scope: Generic termination audit records hold and derived-to-qpos displacement. Plug-specific distance/last-three/qpos-threshold violation counters are null for these tasks; they do not validate the non-plug withdrawal/speed/XY/height conjunction.
objective_and_success_applicability.hold_interpretation: Three 25 Hz discrete samples span 0.08 s between endpoints; this is not proof of continuous 0.12 s dwell.

recommended_first_matched_comparison.reason: Same live wrist+external image streams and GRU. Fixed home view versus one-second camera positioning versus continued feedback-driven camera motion.
recommended_first_matched_comparison.controls: Retain wrist as the strong conventional negative control. Home view0 is an unsearched baseline, not best-static; an eventual fixed-view selection must use validation and account for search cost. Scheduled is a later open-loop motion control, not needed for the first small readiness pilot.
recommended_first_matched_comparison.initial_condition_semantics: Camera moves only during the first second; afterward camera joint targets remain fixed and both RGB streams remain live. All conditions share the first-second manipulation pause.
recommended_first_matched_comparison.matching: Within each task match source, seed, transition budget,N,image/FOV,GRU,objective,initialstd,physics/timing and occluder distribution. Report 5 extra camera actions and their common action cost for initial/active.
recommended_first_matched_comparison.stage_order: After the plug gate, establish learnability on explicitly clean episodes first. Only then compare the same camera conditions under separately labeled dynamic training. Keep failures and null gaps.

bounded_screen_budget_proposed_not_appro.interpretation: A learning-health screen; sparse success at 100 updates cannot establish that active perception is useless. No long extension is authorized here.

dynamic_world_sweep_v1.distribution: World-space optical sweep independent of camera policy, object, goal or hidden state. No panel collision. Same distribution across camera conditions; do not claim episode-perfect causal pairing from seed alone.
dynamic_world_sweep_v1.observations: Actor gets no timers/panel parameters. Critic retains onset/duration/direction and adds centerXYZ+travel (four privileged values).
dynamic_world_sweep_v1.launcher_limit: common.sh forwards OCCLUSION but not custom dynamic parameter environment variables. Defaults work through the launcher; use direct train CLI for explicit custom distributions.
dynamic_world_sweep_v1.compatibility: Legacy clean/static/phase/random retain old behavior/dimensions. Dynamic changes critic dimension: train fresh, do not resume a legacy-mode checkpoint as dynamic. Actor-only evaluate --occlusion dynamic is supported via with_occlusion and should be labeled a distribution-shift test.
dynamic_world_sweep_v1.alternative_horizon: Default dynamic onset/duration scale with episode_seconds; explicit ranges must clear before timeout.
dynamic_world_sweep_v1.legitimate_controls: Panel clears; waiting, memory and favorable static views remain valid. Do not shorten deadlines or change geometry to force a positive active-policy gap.

existing_evidence.native_scope: Three occluder seeds per task with fixed manipulation resets; privileged scripts. All three task episodes held success for 3 steps and clean/dynamic qpos matched exactly. This is mechanical/optical feasibility, not learned-policy performance.
existing_evidence.interpretation: Strong unaffected wrist visibility makes current transfer/push useful negative controls. Moving the panel reduces external visibility but has not demonstrated that continual active camera motion improves learned success.

gpu_gate.checks: CUDA RGB, midpoint moving panel parity, partial resets, original pipeline regressions

existing_evidence.gpu_scope: All-task optical rendering/pose/reset parity was tested at 5badc6e. This is not a full learned-policy transfer/push success evaluation or a PPO learning test under 11a591f.

push_optional_stale_state_scenario.interpretation: Separate matched disturbance scenario. Measure actual displacement and camera visibility before interpreting stale-state dependence; fixed small force does not guarantee a useful active-perception problem.

launcher_adjustment_rule: Use train_push.sbatch for push. Selected seed0 indices6/9/15 dispatch wrist_static/initial/active. Change OCCLUSION from clean to dynamic only as a separately labeled experiment; no case matrix or jobs are generated. Set a separate RESULT_ROOT for each occlusion mode (artifacts/follow_on/clean versus artifacts/follow_on/dynamic) to prevent overwriting telemetry filenames; assign fresh run IDs/tags.
environment_hygiene: For any later fresh submission clear inherited RESUME,WANDB_RUN_ID,WANDB_RESUME,WANDB_USERNAME,DRY_RUN,SBATCH array defaults and stale task/run-label/perturbation overrides. Set fresh unique W&B IDs/tags per selected run and label source/condition/occlusion explicitly.
evaluation_requirements: Use held-out validation seed10000,N128 and512 episodes with the same batch size across comparisons; these tasks have no four-way plug variants. Capture actual evaluated trajectories, repeat validation, and record success, completion time, terminal physical criteria, camera joint travel and source/checkpoint hashes. GPU repeats need not be episode-identical; no test-set selection.
remaining_gates: Parent entry decision after trustworthy plug repair and completed HP review.
Task-specific GPU physical success auditing including XY/height/withdrawal/speed; current_qpos label alone is insufficient.
One bounded source11a-compatible GPU learning/sensor smoke before expanding training budgets.
Validation-selected fixed view and independently repeated/training-seed results before an active-perception performance claim.
